column1: # Booby traps on the lane (Corne 15 Oct 2026: "something that slows your firing, or cancels out your critical
# attack percentage for a limited time"). Touch one and its effect runs for `seconds`; shoot it to 0 hp first
# and it is destroyed harmlessly. Values are ours, first guesses - tune from run logs.
# effect: fire_rate_mult (fire rate x amount) | no_crit (crit chance 0, amount unused).
# weight: integer roll weight, must sum to 100.
